select t4.warehorse || '-' || t4.position_sign as positionName, t.batch, t.position_stock_batch_num, COALESCE(t3.pieces_sign,'-') pieces_chn from ${positionStockBatchTableName} t left join ${stockTableName} t1 on t.stock_code = t1.primary_key left join ${productPartTableName} t2 on t1.product_part_code = t2.primary_key left join ${piecesTableName} t3 on t2.pcs = t3.primary_key left join ${positionTableName} t4 on t.position_code = t4.primary_key where t.stock_code = #{requestData.stockCode} and t.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and t.delete_flag = false and t.position_code in
#{positionCode}
and t.batch like '%'|| #{requestData.batch} ||'%'
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
